name: attio
description: Read and update Attio CRM records, lists, notes, tasks and comments
long_description: Bring an Attio workspace access token (API key); the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the token lists the workspace's objects (GET /v2/objects), which changes nothing and needs the object_configuration:read scope. A Sprite can then read objects, lists and their attributes; query, search, create and update records such as people, companies and deals; add records to lists and update list entries; read and create notes, tasks and comments; read meetings, call recordings, email metadata and workspace members; and run SQL queries on plans that include them. Attio enforces the token's scopes on every request. Deletes, merges, value-history rewrites, upsert and overwrite PUTs, schema changes (objects, lists, attributes, views), webhooks, the email blocklist and sequence unsubscribes are not forwarded.

examples.title: List the workspace's objects (people, companies, deals and custom objects)
List the attributes of the people object
Search people and companies by name, domain or email
Query the 10 most recently created companies
notes: A query is a POST but changes nothing. Page with `limit` and `offset` in the body.

examples.title: Create a person (changes your Attio data)
notes: Create answers 409 if a unique attribute such as `email_addresses` already matches a person. To change that person instead, find it with `POST /v2/objects/records/search` and update it with `PATCH /v2/objects/people/records/RECORD_ID`.

examples.title: Add a note to a company (changes your Attio data); replace RECORD_ID
Create a task linked to a company (changes your Attio data); replace RECORD_ID
List the entries in a list; replace LIST

messages.400: Attio rejected the request (%{status}); check the body's code and message
messages.403: This Attio token lacks a scope this request needs, or the plan does not include it; edit the token's scopes in Workspace settings → Developers
messages.404: Not found in Attio; check the object or list slug and the record or entry id
messages.409: Attio found a conflict with an existing value on a unique attribute; find the existing record and update it with PATCH instead
messages.429: Attio rate limit reached; wait for the Retry-After time and retry
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Attio; retry later

presentation.tagline: Work with your Attio CRM from a Sprite without putting your access token on it.
presentation.setup: A workspace admin opens Workspace settings → Developers in Attio, clicks + New access token, names it and sets its scopes. The token needs `object_configuration:read` for the key check. Add `record_permission:read`, `list_configuration:read`, `list_entry:read`, `note:read`, `task:read`, `user_management:read` (tasks need it) and `comment:read` for read-only use, and the matching `read-write` scopes only for what the Sprite should change.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the token lists your workspace's objects with `GET /v2/objects`, which changes nothing. Attio lists no per-request charge for its REST API. Records a Sprite creates count toward your plan's record limit, and additional records are a paid add-on. `POST /v2/sql` works only on plans that include SQL access, and `GET /v2/emails` only once Attio support enables it for the workspace. Attio allows 100 read and 25 write requests per second, and `POST /v2/sql` 2 per second.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Forwarded: `GET /v2/self`; `GET` on objects, lists and their attributes, select options and statuses; `POST /v2/objects/:object/records/query`, `POST /v2/objects/:object/records`, `GET` and `PATCH /v2/objects/:object/records/:record_id`, record attribute values and record entries, `POST /v2/objects/records/search`; `POST /v2/lists/:list/entries/query`, `POST /v2/lists/:list/entries`, `GET` and `PATCH /v2/lists/:list/entries/:entry_id` and entry attribute values; `GET` and `POST /v2/notes`, `GET /v2/notes/:note_id`; `GET` and `POST /v2/tasks`, `GET` and `PATCH /v2/tasks/:task_id`; `GET /v2/threads` and `/v2/threads/:thread_id`; `POST /v2/comments`, `GET /v2/comments/:comment_id`; `GET` on meetings and their call recordings, `GET /v2/emails`, `GET` on workspace members; `POST /v2/sql`. Not forwarded: any delete, record merges, attribute value-history rewrites, the upsert and overwrite `PUT` routes (they remove multiselect values not in the request), creating or changing objects, lists, attributes or views, webhooks, files, activities, the workspace blocklist and sequence unsubscribes. Attio enforces the token's scopes on every allowed route.

usage_notes: Objects and lists are addressed by slug (`people`, `companies`, `deals`) or by id; records, entries, notes, tasks and other resources by UUID.

Most list and query routes page with `limit` and `offset` (in the body for `POST .../query`, in the query string for `GET` lists). `GET /v2/meetings`, call recordings and `GET /v2/emails` page with `limit` and the `cursor` the previous response returned. There is no pagination header.
Errors are `{"status_code": 400, "type": "invalid_request_error", "code": "validation_type", "message": "..."}`. A 429 carries `Retry-After` as an HTTP date, which the gateway passes back.
